name: Empire 90
description: A compact Empire chandelier with a round crystal crown, tapered crystal neck and rounded basket, finished with warm gold-tone metal bands.
imageSource: Brochure PDF page 3, labelled product photograph
note: Confirm specifications, current finish and photo/model pairing with Simon.
appearance: Round faceted crystal globe above a narrow metal collar; long tapered crystal neck widens to a continuous decorated metal shoulder ring; deep rounded lattice crystal basket with a pointed bottom finial. The bulbs are enclosed within the crystal body. No projecting candle arms.
primaryReferenceInstruction: The second chandelier from the left, behind the cropped foreground fixture, is the identity subject. Other sizes and fixtures in the group are background only.

name: Marie Therese 100
description: An ornate clear crystal chandelier with tiered, sweeping candle-style arms, silver-tone candle sleeves and hanging crystal pendants.
note: Confirm specifications, current finish and photo/model pairing with Simon.
appearance: Clear curved glass arms and dishes, silver-tone candle sleeves, faceted hanging drops, tall decorative upper curls and a central lower crystal pendant. The open arm construction must stay visible; do not turn it into an enclosed Empire basket.
primaryReferenceInstruction: Use the single clear chandelier against the dark background. Preserve the clear glass arms and silver-tone candle sleeves.

name: Marie Therese 150
description: A broad statement chandelier with layered clear glass candle-style arms, crystal drops and a cascading lower pendant.
imageSource: Brochure PDF page 10, labelled product photograph
note: Confirm specifications, current finish and photo/model pairing with Simon.
appearance: Multiple broad tiers of sweeping clear glass arms and candle cups, clear hanging crystal pendants, upper decorative curls and a tapering cascade of central drops. Preserve the broad one-to-one height-to-width proportions and the photographed arm structure.
primaryReferenceInstruction: Use the single large clear chandelier centred in the photograph. The suspension chain is separate from the fixture body.

name: Empire 200
description: An oversized Empire chandelier with a large round crystal crown, long flared neck and deep rounded basket in a decorated gold-tone frame.
note: Confirm specifications, current finish and photo/model pairing with Simon.
appearance: Large spherical crystal globe above the collar; tall flared trumpet-shaped crystal neck; broad decorated horizontal metal band; deep gridded crystal basket and pointed finial. No projecting candle arms. Preserve the two-to-one height-to-diameter proportions.
primaryReferenceInstruction: Use the large complete foreground chandelier on the RIGHT. The smaller-looking matching fixture behind it and the different designs at the edges are background only.

name: French Crystal Empire 105
description: A slender French crystal chandelier with a small ornamental crown, long crystal strands and a wide pierced gold-tone band above a rounded hanging crystal basket.
imageSource: Brochure PDF page 15, labelled product photograph
note: Simon to confirm standard versus vintage French Crystal variant; other supplied screenshots appear to show vintage metalwork.
appearance: Small openwork crown with no spherical crystal globe; slender upper crystal strands flare to a wide ornate pierced metal band; broad hanging crystal prisms, rounded basket and pendant finial. This is the standard French Crystal Empire 105; the vintage variant shown separately in the brochure has different metalwork.
primaryReferenceInstruction: Use the single standard French Crystal Empire 105 in the brochure photograph. Do not substitute the separate vintage variant or add projecting candle arms.

name: Vintage Necklace Empire 180
description: A wide vintage chandelier with a draped crystal canopy, broad rounded bowl, decorative gold-tone rim and external candle-style lights.
note: Confirm specifications, current finish and photo/model pairing with Simon.
appearance: Small crown supporting a wide draped crystal canopy, a very broad rounded crystal bowl, ornate warm gold-tone outer rim and a stepped crystal pendant underneath. Exactly 12 exterior candle-style lights around the rim; the other 40 bulbs are inside the body. Preserve the full 1.8 m width and the shallow broad bowl silhouette.
primaryReferenceInstruction: Use the single large necklace chandelier against the dark background. Its external arms belong around the rim; the internal bulbs must not become extra external arms.
